about_short_description.short_description: Setpoint.io develops a platform purpose-built for the future of asset-backed lending.

product.name: Capital Markets Operating System (Capital OS)
product.description: A platform that integrates with borrowers and lenders to manage debt facilities, automate borrowing base calculations, and ensure compliance across asset-backed lending portfolios.

product.name: Third-Party Due Diligence Services
product.description: Tech-enabled services that provide verification and certification of collateral documents and funding requests to support asset-backed lending transactions.

product.name: Portfolio Manager
product.description: A tool within the Capital OS platform for real-time monitoring, forecasting, and optimization of capital usage and compliance across lending portfolios.

product.name: Collateral Manager
product.description: A system to track data, documents, lender requirements, and operational workflows throughout the lifecycle of asset-backed loans.

product.name: Valuations Manager
product.description: An automated tool for managing Broker Price Opinions (BPO), appraisals, and Automated Valuation Models (AVM) to support asset valuation in lending transactions.
